subject: Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance Recodification
overview: The council approved a comprehensive overhaul of the city's zoning ordinance after two years of deliberation and passed a Home Rule Petition to authorize the election of a Charter Commission.

items.title: Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance Recodification
items.summary: The council approved the recodification of the entire city zoning ordinance following a public hearing and the inclusion of over 70 recommendations from the Community Development Board.

items.title: Charter Commission Home Rule Petition
items.summary: The council approved a Home Rule Petition to authorize the election of a nine-member Charter Commission, with some councilors arguing the process should instead be initiated via a signature-gathering campaign.

items.title: MBTA Multi-Family Zoning Guidance
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt presented draft state guidance for the MBTA multi-family zoning requirement, which may mandate the city zone for over 6,000 units to remain eligible for state grants.

items.title: Tufts Laboratory Evacuation Update Request
items.summary: The council requested an update from the administration and Tufts University regarding a chemical laboratory evacuation that occurred at 62 Talbot Street.

items.title: Library Foundation and Attendance Update
items.summary: The library director reported that the foundation has raised over $6.1 million and that circulation has significantly increased since the new building opened.

items.title: License Commission Appointment and Board Vacancies
items.summary: The council tabled the appointment of Robert Delfano for one week to pressure the administration to address the lack of a quorum on the Board of Registrars.

items.title: Routine Business and Memorial Resolutions
items.summary: The council approved a food truck permit for Hormel Stadium and passed memorial resolutions for Dolores Carroll, Carol Sharpton, James Schena Jr., and William Casey.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: The council approved committee reports regarding the proposed public surveillance ordinance and the Charter Commission petition.
